main_measure.name: pooled slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast, day-clustered t
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope t >= 2 (100+ cases) and largest |forecast| third above smallest; reject if t <= -2 (100+ cases)

supporting_check.name: mean directional excess 5-bar return, largest |forecast| third minus smallest third

decided_by: Slope t >= 2 with at least 100 cases and the largest |forecast| third above the smallest third.
reading: Calm profile read as regime 'unknown' (no 'chop' veto) and the day's direction as the sign of the raw component (price return where missing); the slope t uses OLS with residual-score deviations summed per day (cluster-robust, G/(G-1) correction); the coin's mean 5-bar return is over all grid bars of all its windows; thirds are floor(n/3) cases at each end of |forecast|.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0005111 on the check folds against +0.0009015 on every fold
